stories.title: Pakistan condemns targeting of Aramco building, demands Houthis cease all attacks against Saudi Arabia
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday condemned the Houthi attack on Saudi oil giant Aramco’s corporate office in Riyadh, demanding that the rebel group “immediately and unconditionally” cease all attacks against Saudi Arabia, the Foreign Office (FO) said.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns Houthi attack on Saudi Aramco building, denounces targeting of civilian facilities
stories.brief: Pakistan on Monday condemned the attempted attack by the Houthis on a Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh, while expressing concern over the targeting of civilian facilities.

stories.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
stories.brief: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.

stories.title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse
stories.brief: New figures suggest hazel dormice may be recovering after decades of decline, with warmer summers boosting survival.

stories.title: Pakistani farmers in long fight to make German firms pay for 2022 flood damage
stories.brief: The companies are being targeted not over specific operations in Pakistan, but because of their climate-warming emissions. Heidelberg Materials told AFP its operations were compliant with German laws and that firms could not be expected to retroactively face different standards.

stories.title: PM directs foreign ministry to urgently ‘escalate humanitarian assistance’ for rain-hit Gaza
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said on Monday he had directed the foreign ministry to pursue all possible means to urgently “escalate humanitarian assistance” to Gaza, where heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia investors launch fund to boost trade, investment
stories.brief: The Saudi-Pakistan Joint ⁠Business Council (SPJBC), formed by ​the governments of both countries, said ​the fund's initial size was "multi-hundred million", which was expected to expand based ​on opportunities across sectors. Earlier in October, SPJBC Chairman Prince Mansour bin Mohammad Al Saud visited Pakistan, leading a high-level Saudi business delegation.

stories.title: Pakistan farmers in long fight to make German firms pay for flood damage
stories.brief: In a Pakistani village nestled in rice fields, Abdul Hafeez Khoso remembers the vast industrial zones he saw in Germany when he visited to file a pioneering climate legal case. The companies are being targeted not over specific operations in Pakistan, but because of their climate-warming emissions.

stories.title: Tarbela T-5 project work suspended indefinitely after protective bund breach
stories.brief: A breach in a protective bund at the Tarbela Dam's T-5 hydropower project on Monday caused a large volume of water to flood Tunnel Five, prompting the suspension of construction work indefinitely, officials said.

stories.title: IEDs, ammunition recovered from terrorist hideouts inside mosques in North Waziristan: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces recovered a large cache of improvised explosive devices (IEDs), explosives, weapons and ammunition from two terrorist hideouts established inside mosques in North Waziristan, the military's media wing said on Monday.

stories.title: NCCIA warns citizens against fake Rs13,000 cash reward messages in PM's name
stories.brief: According to an NCCIA spokesperson, cyber fraudsters were attempting to deceive citizens through fake reward messages claiming that PM Shehbaz was offering Rs13,000 in cash. He said such messages could contain suspicious links designed to steal personal information and banking details, exposing citizens to online financial fraud.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz directs MoFA to step up humanitarian aid to Gaza
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Monday directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) to pursue "all possible means" to step up urgent humanitarian assistance to Gaza, and condemned Israel’s continued restrictions on aid and violations of the ceasefire and international law.

stories.title: Birds return to waterfowl park after oil vandalism
stories.brief: The vandalism of a nearby home heating oil tank resulted in the death of 13 birds from the park.

stories.title: Who is the suspected Chinese spy at centre of the Nvidia investigation?
stories.brief: Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, had a close relationship with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, reports say.

stories.title: UK court hands comedian Russell Brand 10.5 years for rape, sexual assault
stories.brief: Brand was convicted last week of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three more between 2004 ​and 2009.

stories.title: Rising cost of living tests UK's net zero ambitions
stories.brief: From floods to wildfires to heatwaves, 2026 is the year it became hard to ignore the impact of climate change on UK weather. But will soaring living costs affect the government’s commitment to tackling climate change?

stories.title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
stories.brief: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.

stories.title: Scientists predict 2026 hottest year on record as climate talks begin
stories.brief: Scientists are predictng this could be the hottest year on record as the COP31 climate summit opens.
